summary: Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing a shareholder benefit program (loyalty perks) for long-term holders—this is a routine dividend-adjacent loyalty scheme, not a special situation. No stake, price, premium, or deal terms exist. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is a foreign private issuer report that simply describes conditions for receiving V Points and deposit rate perks. As a non-US filer, the 6-K equates to a voluntary disclosure. Use 'None' because this is purely a shareholder incentive program.
